editorial.blurb: Velvet Taco nails bold, creative flavors with thoughtful execution—a fast-casual spot that genuinely cares about every bite.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the rotisserie chicken deal on a less busy day and call ahead; the manager will hold it for you. Great for late-night visits when you want quality tacos after going out, though expect a crowd and tight seating.
